summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan: ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did:** read the full chain end-to-end (no edits) — `WatchlistPage.tsx`, `client/src/lib/api.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`, `App.tsx` routing, `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts`, `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `db/auth.ts`, and `server.ts` middleware wiring. Also checked git history on these files.  **What I found:** the code as it stands today looks correctly scoped end to end: - Client never touches localStorage/sessionStorage for watchlists — `activeId` is pure React state, refetched via `GET /watchlist` on each
